# Vtiger | Product Positioning

| Dimension | Positioning |
| --- | --- |
| Listing in one sentence | Harmonize the full-purpose CRM for sales, marketing, services, projects and inventory view and provide the AI version. |
| Main purchasing motive | Reduction of manual maintenance, harmonization of processes and data, improvement of first-line adoption rates and reduction of critical cycles through automation or AI. |
| Competing boundary | The width of the module may give rise to configuration complexity; AI is at a high level of competence; local compliance and finance need to be integrated accordingly. |
| Evaluation Principles | Validation with real business data does not directly equate a manufacturer ' s demonstration, Logo wall, award or certification to business effects. |
| Scope and boundaries | The breadth of the module may result in configuration complexity; AI and advanced privileges are in high brackets; local compliance and finance need to be integrated accordingly. |
